The answer surfaces none of these 11 items -- it only reports CAPEC-21's Status/Abstraction and its 7 CAPEC-side (capec:attack-pattern:21:mitigation:N) mitigations, which are not the gold-required entities at all. Checking the evidence itself (logic_flow.results): q1 and q5 both queried CAPEC-21's outgoing MAPS_TO edges and the facet block confirms 'MAPS_TO'/'out'/count:3 exists in the graph, but both queries used the 'describe' template, which only returns facet counts, not the actual related TaxonomyEntry nodes -- 'related': [] in both records. So the three T-numbers were never actually retrieved into evidence, and the pipeline's abstention ('the attack source does not establish which ATT&CK techniques map to CAPEC-21... because q6 produced no seed identifiers') is consistent with what the evidence shows (q1's join_values are empty), i.e. a genuine upstream retrieval/template-selection gap rather than a fabrication. Every fact the narrative and claims do state (CAPEC-21 id/name, Status=Stable, Abstraction=Meta, the 7 capec:attack-pattern:21:mitigation:1..7 ids and their HAS_MITIGATION relation) is directly grounded in the q1/q3/q5/q6 records, so faithfulness and groundedness are high and no hallucinations were found. But because the core deliverable of the question -- the technique correlation and the ATT&CK mitigations tied to those techniques -- is entirely absent, completeness is 1/12 (only CAPEC-21 itself surfaced) and correctness is very low; this is graded INCORRECT because the pipeline fails the actual question despite behaving honestly about the gap.
